_meta.purpose: Installation evidence catalogue · Agent B · finishing + inspection + scenarios (17 topics)
_meta.governance_rule: Evidence only. Zero installation procedures authored. 'expert_author_required' where source pool runs dry.
_meta.scope: Topics 1-17 covering finishing components (final_fixing · balustrade · handrail · newel · string) · inspection + sign-off + snagging · post-install failures · scenario installs (loft · renovation · historic · timber-floor · concrete-floor · steel-frame)
_meta.cross_reference_note: Reuses source_catalogue.json entries by src-XXX ID where they cover the topic. New evidence entries introduce src IDs in the src-A26 onwards range to avoid collision with the master 25-entry catalogue.
_meta.governance_reminder: Every 'what_source_discusses' is descriptive ('covers X'), NEVER prescriptive ('do X'). No installation instructions authored anywhere in this file.

concrete_floor_installation.gap_note: DPM (damp-proof membrane) and levelling detailing beneath a stair base on concrete is addressed in floor / substrate guidance (Approved Document C and manufacturer screed datasheets) rather than in staircase-specific literature. Certified expert author should bridge from BS EN 1992-4 + Doc C at authoring time.
